about:
I enjoy the full lifecycle of a feature: shaping the requirement with the client, designing the data model, building the API and finishing the interface with care.

I like small pull requests, clear naming and tests that explain intent. Outside client work I mentor newer developers and contribute to our internal component library.

projects.title: Client Portal
projects.summary: A secure customer portal with role-based access, analytics dashboards and document workflows.
projects.details: Built the portal from scratch for a professional services client. Customers sign in to track engagements, upload documents and see live reporting. I owned the API design, the permission model and most of the React front end.
highlights: Cut page load time by 48% with route-level code splitting
Audit log for every document action

projects.title: Booking API
projects.summary: Scheduling and payments API handling availability, reminders and refunds across time zones.
projects.details: A REST API that powers booking for web and mobile clients. It handles recurring availability, payment capture and automated reminders.

projects.title: Atlas UI Kit
projects.summary: A shared component library so internal products look and behave the same across teams.
projects.details: A typed React component library with documentation in Storybook, theming tokens and accessibility checks in CI.
highlights: Light and dark themes from one token set
